summary: Jetlog is a self-hosted application designed for recording and viewing personal flight history. It helps you maintain a private logbook of your travel data rather than relying on commercial third-party platforms. The project is distributed under the GPL-2.0 licence.
goodFor: It is well-suited for aviation enthusiasts who want to keep an independent, self-hosted record of their flights.
watchOut: The project has a relatively modest community footprint and development activity has slowed recently, which might affect long-term maintenance.
deployNotes: Since it is distributed as a Docker container, you will typically need to mount a persistent volume for storing application data and configure a reverse proxy to handle TLS.
